description: _Matriz de Identificacion de Activos infraestructura Critica is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Fundación Gilberto Alzate Avendaño - FUGA. Son los activos de información Critica de la Fundación Gilberto Álzate Avendaño. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Fundación Gilberto Alzate Avendaño - FUGA. Its tags are activos criticos infraestructura. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-11-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
